observed.title: UNSPIN — Inspect, correct, and reuse chart and spreadsheet data
observed.excerpt:
UNSPIN
Turn charts and spreadsheets into data you can inspect, correct, and reuse.

Upload a file, choose the region that matters, check every value against its source, then export it with the history of what you changed.

Drop a chart, PDF, or spreadsheet here
Choose a file

PNG, JPEG, WebP, PDF, CSV, XLSX · up to 10 MB

Spreadsheets: up to 20,000 rows and 64 columns per import · PDFs: up to 200 pages · Images: up to 40 megapixels

Legacy .xls, macro-enabled .xlsm, password-protected files, archives, and executables are refused. The file name is shown to you only; the type is decided from the file's contents.

Spreadsheets (CSV, XLSX)
Parsed on this server. Nothing is sent to an AI model.
Charts and PDFs (PNG, JPEG, WebP, PDF)
Only the region you select is sent to Google Gemini, after you confirm. Values read from charts are marked as estimates.

Work is kept for this session only and is lost when the server restarts. Export your results to keep them.
